title: 第9章 阳天逆第10章 杀他如杀鸡
slug: 你一个武夫谁让你炼剑的
lines: 看到那名长相绝美的白衣女子主动邀请秦关，众人似是突然明白了什么。
今晚明眼人都能看出来，那个白衣女子才是真正的大佬，而她主动邀请秦关，显然是认识秦关的，而且关系一看就不一般。
天宝阁之所以能答应秦关的条件，完全是因为那白衣女子。
另一边，二人走了一会停下，白衣女子笑看向秦关：“自我介绍一下，我叫姜连月。”
秦关点头：“姑娘有事？”
“我想与公子合作。”姜连月直接开门见山。
“合作，干什么？”秦关皱眉。
姜连月道：“秦公子可听过阳天逆？”
听到这三个字秦关神情一动：“姑娘知道这位前辈？”
姜连月点头：“五日之后，万妖谷会有一处上古秘境现世，据我掌握的消息，这个秘境很可能和阳天逆有关。”
听到姜连月的话，秦关内心顿时有些激动。
阳天逆他曾听师父说过，此人是一位剑武双修的奇人，是数万年来唯一一个没有丹田也能修炼剑道的武夫。
据说他创出了一门奇特的功法，即使没有丹田也能凝聚天地灵气修炼。
剑道！
这是一个让秦关做梦都向往的武道极致，从小受师父影响，他时时刻刻都想成为像师父那样的一个超然天地的剑道强者。
周流天地外，便历山川遥，谁不想御剑遨游，自在极意，奈何自己天生没有丹田，只能做一个苦逼的贴地武夫。
这些年来师父也曾一直为他寻找阳天逆的踪迹，想让自己获得阳天逆的武道传承修炼剑道，但奈何年代久远，阳天逆在两万多年前就销声匿迹，查不到半点信息。
刚才听到姜连月提起阳天逆，秦关的内心着实激动了一把。
看到秦关神色动容，姜连月又道：
“现在有很多势力都已得知此事，所以我想与秦公子合作，一起探索秘境，至于宝物到时候各凭机缘如何？”
秦关听后点头：“可以。”
“秦公子，关于我们之间合作的事先不要声张，到时候应对各势力说不定能出其不意。”
“嗯，明白。”秦关点头。
“秦公子，我可以问你一个问题吗？”姜连月美眸轻挑笑道。
“你说。”秦关道。
“以公子的实力为何要来一个小小的南家当倒插门啊？”
“公子别误会，我就是单纯的好奇！”
“缘分。”秦关想了想说出两个字。
闻言，姜连月看了眼远处的南柔，发现南柔正好也在看她，不过那边南柔很快低下了头。
“你的未婚妻很美。”姜连月笑了一声转身离开。
随后，天宝阁众人也跟着离开。
秦关则是折返了回去。
看到秦关走过来，南顺达突然笑脸迎上：
“哈哈，不愧是我南家的姑爷，不光实力超群，这人脉也不一般啊！”
南圆通也急忙点头道：
“确实，只是略微出手就给我们南家赚来了一百瓶炼气散，这下我们族人不缺修炼资源了！”
content_en:
Seeing the beautiful woman in white actively inviting Qin Guan, everyone seemed to suddenly understand something.
Anyone with a discerning eye can see tonight that the woman in white is the real boss, and she took the initiative to invite Qin Guan. She obviously knows Qin Guan, and the relationship is extraordinary at first glance.
The reason why Tianbao Pavilion was able to agree to Qin Guan's conditions was entirely because of the woman in white.
On the other side, the two walked for a while and stopped. The woman in white looked at Qinguan with a smile: "Introduce yourself, my name is Jiang Lianyue."
Qin Guan nodded: "Miss, is there something wrong?"
"I want to cooperate with Young Master." Jiang Lianyue got straight to the point.
"Cooperation, for what?" Qin Guan frowned.
Jiang Lianyue said: "Master Qin, have you ever heard of Yang Tianni?"
Qin Guan's expression changed when he heard these three words: "Do you know this senior?"
Jiang Lianyue nodded: "In five days, an ancient secret realm will appear in the Valley of Ten Thousand Demons. According to the information I have, this secret realm is likely to be related to Yang Tianni."
After hearing Jiang Lianyue's words, Qin Guan suddenly felt excited.
Yang Tianni once heard his master say that this man was a strange man who practiced swordsmanship and martial arts. He was the only martial artist in tens of thousands of years who could practice swordsmanship without having a Dantian.
It is said that he created a unique skill that can condense the spiritual energy of heaven and earth for practice even without Dantian.
kendo!
This is the pinnacle of martial arts that Qing Guan dreams of. Influenced by his master since childhood, he always wants to become a transcendent swordsman like his master.
Traveling around the world, you can see mountains and rivers far away. Who doesn't want to travel with a sword and feel at ease, but he is born with no Dantian, so he can only be a hard-working martial artist.
Over the years, his master has been looking for traces of Yang Tianni for him, hoping that he can obtain Yang Tianni's martial arts inheritance and practice swordsmanship. However, it has been a long time since Yang Tianni disappeared more than 20,000 years ago, and no information can be found.
Qin Guan was really excited when he heard Jiang Lianyue mention Yang Tianni just now.
Seeing Qin Guan's expression moved, Jiang Lianyue said again:
"Now many forces have learned about this, so I want to cooperate with Mr. Qin to explore the secret realm together. As for the treasure, how about it depends on chance?"
Qin Guan nodded after hearing this: "Okay."
"Master Qin, please don't make any announcement about our cooperation in advance. We may be able to take the various forces by surprise when the time comes."
"Yeah, I understand." Qing Guan nodded.
"Master Qin, can I ask you a question?" Jiang Lianyue said with a smile with beautiful eyes.
"Say." Qin Guandao.
"With your master's strength, why would you want a small Nan family member to step in on your door?"
"Master, don't get me wrong, I'm just curious!"
"Fate." Qin Guan thought for a while and said two words.
Hearing this, Jiang Lianyue glanced at Nanrou in the distance and found that Nanrou was also looking at her, but Nanrou quickly lowered her head.
"Your fiancée is beautiful." Jiang Lianyue smiled and turned to leave.
Afterwards, everyone in Tianbao Pavilion also left.
Qinguan turned back.
Seeing Qing Guan approaching, Nan Shunda suddenly greeted him with a smile:
"Haha, you are worthy of being my uncle from the Nan family. Not only is he super powerful, but his connections are also extraordinary!"
Nan Yuantong also nodded hurriedly and said:
"Indeed, with just a few tricks, our Nan family earned a hundred bottles of Qi Refining Powder. Now our clan has no shortage of cultivation resources!"
